title: Asiad: Ubas places 11th in long jump final; Bossong tops heat in 800m
summary: Veteran campaigner Janry Ubas finished 11th among 12 competitors in the final of the men's long jump in the 2026 Asian Games, Monday evening at the Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium in Nagoya.
